entries.subject: DAMIT 390: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: DAMIT model 390, version 2016-04-19, pole (242°, 46°), period 18.35123 h, taken unchanged from the archive. Mirror solution 391 recorded as an alternative.

entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: 16.4 ± 1.3 km, thermophysical volume-equivalent diameter fitted with this shape model. DAMIT marks model 390 as size-calibrated by the thermophysical fit of Hanuš et al. (2015): D = 16.4 ± 1.3 km, thermal inertia 170 (90–260), geometric albedo 0.21 ± 0.04. The mirror pole, model 391, fits D = 16.8 ± 1.5 km. NEOWISE lists 15.812 ± 0.111 km (Masiero et al. 2014) and 17.739 ± 0.894 km (Masiero et al. 2012).

entries.finding: No spacecraft or resolved ground-based image of this asteroid was found in the archives searched for this package.
